sections.text_helper: Section 18.4.15 "TIMx auto-reload register (TIMx_ARR)(x = 2 to 3)" in chapter 18 (General-purpose timers (TIM2/TIM3)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 509.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x2C
Reset value: 0xFFFF FFFF
Bits 31:16 ARR[31:16]: High auto-reload value
Bits 15:0 ARR[15:0]: Low Auto-reload value
ARR is the value to be loaded in the actual auto-reload register.
Refer to the Section18.3.1: Time-base unit on page447 for more details about ARR update
and behavior.
The counter is blocked while the auto-reload value is null.

fields.name: ARR[15:0]
fields.description: Low Auto-reload value ARR is the value to be loaded in the actual auto-reload register. Refer to the Section18.3.1: Time-base unit on page447 for more details about ARR update and behavior. The counter is blocked while the auto-reload value is null.
